name: Min-Max 4x + Hybrid
description: Jeff Nippards Min-Max (4 pass/vecka, 12 veckor) med hybridtillägg. Passordning: mobilitetsflow -> explosivt -> styrkepasset -> funktion/kondition. Nästan varje set ska tas till failure eller 1 rep från (RIR står per set och vecka). Vikten väljer du själv - appen föreslår förra veckans vikt. Vecka 1 = intro, vecka 7 = deload, från vecka 8 används intensitetstekniker på sista setet. Starta varje pass med ~5 min lätt cardio. Tilläggen får aldrig försämra arbetsseten: går passet över 70 min, ta först bort funktions-finishern, sedan minska HIIT. Onsdag = spinning 45-60 min (mest zon 2), fredag/söndag vila (promenad, valfri lätt mobilitet).

mm_lyingLegCurl.name: Lying Leg Curl
mm_lyingLegCurl.notes: Set the machine so that you get the biggest stretch possible at the bottom. Prevent your butt from popping up as you curl.

mm_squat.name: Squat (Your Choice)
mm_squat.notes: This can be a Barbell Back Squat, Barbell Front Squat, Pendulum Squat, Hack Squat, Belt Squat, or Smith Machine Squat.

mm_barbellInclinePress.name: Barbell Incline Press
mm_barbellInclinePress.notes: A 30° or 45° bench will work here. Pause for 1 second at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

mm_inclineDbYRaise.name: Incline DB Y-Raise
mm_inclineDbYRaise.notes: Use a 30° incline bench (back against the bench) and lift the weight up and out in a Y shape.

mm_pullUp.name: Pull-Up (Wide Grip)
mm_pullUp.notes: Control the negative and feel your lats pulling apart. Full ROM!

mm_standingCalfRaise.name: Standing Calf Raise
mm_standingCalfRaise.notes: 1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet.

mm_closeGripLatPulldown.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
mm_closeGripLatPulldown.notes: Lean back by ~15° and drive your elbows down as you squeeze your shoulder blades together. This should feel like a mix of lats and mid-traps.

mm_chestSupportedTBarRow.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
mm_chestSupportedTBarRow.notes: Flare elbows out at roughly 45° and squeeze your shoulder blades together hard at the top of each rep.

mm_machineShrug.name: Machine Shrug
mm_machineShrug.notes: Think about shrugging "up to your ears". Use straps, if possible.

mm_machineChestPress.name: Machine Chest Press
mm_machineChestPress.notes: 1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

mm_highCableLateralRaise.name: High-Cable Lateral Raise
mm_highCableLateralRaise.notes: Set the cable at roughly hip height. Let your hand go slightly past your midline at the bottom of each rep to get a deep stretch on the side delt.

mm_1ArmReversePecDeck.name: 1-Arm Reverse Pec Deck
mm_1ArmReversePecDeck.notes: Sweep the weight out to create the largest semi-circle possible with your arm.

mm_cableCrunch.name: Cable Crunch
mm_cableCrunch.notes: Round your lower back as you crunch. Maintain a mind-muscle connection with your 6-pack.

mm_legExtension.name: Leg Extension
mm_legExtension.notes: Set the seat back as far as it will go while still feeling comfortable. Grab the handles as hard as you can to pull your butt down into the seat (using straps can help here).

mm_barbellRdl.name: Barbell RDL
mm_barbellRdl.notes: Stick your glutes straight back as you lower the bar straight down, centered over the middle of your foot. Get a nice deep stretch at the bottom, but keep your spine neutral (don't round forward).

mm_machineHipThrust.name: Machine Hip Thrust
mm_machineHipThrust.notes: Squeeze your glutes hard at the top and control the weight on the way down.

mm_legPress.name: Leg Press
mm_legPress.notes: Feet lower on the platform for more quad focus. Get as deep as you can without excessive back rounding.

mm_standingCalfRaiseLow.name: Standing Calf Raise
mm_standingCalfRaiseLow.notes: 1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet.

mm_bayesianCableCurl.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
mm_bayesianCableCurl.notes: As you curl, optionally lean forward to prevent the cable from hitting your wrist at the top. Control the negative and feel a deep stretch at the bottom of each rep.

mm_overheadCableTricepsExtension.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
mm_overheadCableTricepsExtension.notes: Feel a deep stretch on the triceps throughout the entire negative.

mm_modifiedZottmanCurl.name: Modified Zottman Curl
mm_modifiedZottmanCurl.notes: Hammer curl on the way up and supinated curl (palms up) on the way down.

mm_cableTricepsKickback.name: Cable Triceps Kickback
mm_cableTricepsKickback.notes: Keep your upper arm behind your torso throughout the ROM.

mm_machineLateralRaise.name: Machine Lateral Raise
mm_machineLateralRaise.notes: Focus on squeezing your side delt to move the weight.

mm_deadHang.name: Dead Hang (optional)
mm_deadHang.notes: Try to add a few more seconds each week!
